currency.basis: This exact vector is linked as the bank logo in the currently fetched operating-bank homepage. Current use is supported by live source context, not inferred from source creation time or search summary.

identity.basis: Exact metadata host and bank name match live official header context and Turkish retail banking content; no parent/successor substitution.

assessment.independenceRationale: Homepage and asset are one authoritative primary source. Search provided no independent evidence; identity/current-use gap is directly resolved by exact official header asset linkage, so no copied material counted as independent.
uncertainties: Baseline original attribution is not established; it was observed only as a flat green reference. Exact Compose gradient compatibility and dark-theme small-size contrast are not verified in research.

variant.basis: Standalone eight-part clover selected from official original vector group LOGO, with complete contours, transforms, paint gradients and internal transparency preserved. Separate wordmark omitted in working copy. Transparent mark; no field or backing added. No official circular-avatar claim. Square viewBox only centers complete emblem with uniform unscaled geometry; final theme/small-size fit remains review-stage work.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Full source and exact final show all eight leaves, asymmetric contours, original gradients and internal transparent gaps preserved. No clipping or invented paint. Working/optimized references show no visible change.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Whole clover fits centered at useful scale on both themes. Exact Desktop resized diagnostics at 24/32/48px remain recognizable. Darkest upper tips have low contrast on dark theme, inherent to original vector; complete silhouette and bright lower leaves remain distinguishable. No backing invented to conceal that tradeoff.
candidate.rationale: Restore gradient-green colors and complete original clover contours from the live official header; meaningful source-fidelity correction, not a documented rebrand or claim that flat baseline is obsolete.
candidate.role: Standalone bank clover emblem, separate lettering omitted.
transforms: Preserved original LOGO subtree and gradient definitions; omitted separate wordmark; centered complete emblem in square viewBox -10.5 0 59 59 without distortion.

proposals.reason: Official live Turkish Garanti BBVA website supplies an original gradient-green clover vector. Baseline shows the same general clover silhouette in flat #00673f; source-backed gradient/color correction is visible in independent rsvg reference renders. Propose only the standalone original emblem, not the wordmark. This is not a documented rebrand and does not declare the baseline obsolete.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Replace flat clover rendition with source-original gradient-green emblem from exact live official header. Complete source geometry and internal transparency retained; accompanying wordmark removed for square-cell suitability. Source preserving crop, not tracing/redrawing/recoloring or cosmetic backing normalization.

sources.observation: Retrieved operating Turkish retail-bank homepage with deposit, credit, payments and mobile banking services. Header explicitly labels its linked SVG Garanti BBVA logosu. Downloaded SVG renders a complete gradient-green clover plus black Garanti and blue BBVA lettering. Source has eight original path groups with retained gradients, not raster embedding or traced reconstruction.
